_note: Vaani tool names are unique across the whole platform, so these carry a prefix. Header x-api-key = AGENT_API_KEY (set by hand in Vaani; never commit it).

tools.name: aangan_check_area
tools.description: Check whether the caller's area is inside Pune city or PCMC. Returns status in, out or unknown. If unknown, do not decline; carry on and note the area.

area.description: The locality or city the caller named, for example Kothrud or Nashik

tools.name: chayya_book
tools.description: Call once a caller qualifies. Picks the next designer in rotation, books their calendar, messages them on Telegram and creates the CRM record. Returns a sentence to say to the caller.

call_id.description: The unique id of this call

caller_phone.description: Best number to call, confirmed back to the caller

project_type.description: For example: 3BHK full home, 2 rooms, office, villa

size_sqft.description: Carpet area in sq ft, if given

timeline_text.description: What the caller said about timing

start_within_weeks.description: Weeks from today until they want to start, if known

full_scope.description: True if it is a full home, full floor or a full office fitout

decision_maker.description: Who decides and whether they will attend

source.description: How they found the studio, and who referred them

referral.description: True if a past client, builder or friend referred them

previous_failed_contact.description: True if they say they called or messaged before and nobody replied

budget_note.description: Only if the caller volunteered a number. Otherwise leave out.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for the designer, including anything uncertain

tools.name: chayya_log_call
tools.description: Record a call that was not booked: a decline, an escalation, an info-only call. Include the reason, quoting what the caller said.

decline_reason.description: Which criterion and what the caller said, for example outside service area: caller said Nashik
